name: leetkob
description: LeeTKOB — C++ lab grading system with LLM constraint checking

scripts.dev:web:http: node -e "const { spawn } = require('node:child_process'); spawn(process.platform === 'win32' ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm', ['run', 'dev', '--workspace=web'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: process.platform === 'win32', env: { ...process.env, VITE_API_MODE: 'http', VITE_API_BASE_URL: process.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api' } }).on('exit', (c) => process.exit(c ?? 0))"
